messages:
alice_sells: Heads up — Cobalt Health sent back a 40‑page RFI this morning. They want a capability matrix, POC timeline, pricing bands for Dedicated vs Hosted, and full security answers (SOC2, encryption, data residency). Can folks help triage?

ben_se: I can own the capability matrix. Will map features -> product/roadmap status and add notes on limits (e.g., max seq len per model, streaming support, function calling). Uploading draft in a sec.

priya_soleng: I’ll draft the POC plan and test cases (latency SLOs, throughput targets, data isolation tests). Proposal: 2‑week smoke POC + 4‑week scale run if smoke passes. Need customer region and expected qps to size Dedicated pool.

marco_security: I’ll take the security questionnaire. Quick answers up front: we have SOC2 Type II in prod (report available), data at rest encryption with KMS, customer VPC option for Private, and audit logs for all requests. I’ll attach the completed Qs and certs.

rfp-bot: New file uploaded: https://drive.redwood/cobalt/rfi/1761123345/capability-matrix-v1.xlsx (owner: ben_se)

ben_se: Attached capability matrix v1 (link above). Key notes in the spreadsheet: "Streaming & function-calls = GA (hosted)"; "Quantized model variants = available on Dedicated, not on Hosted in all regions"; "Autoscaling burst = Dedicated only with burst pool". Please review column "Gaps / mitigations" and add product/ops owner.

jenna_ps: For pricing: do we have a simple rack rate I can share? Cobalt asked for monthly committed cost for 1000 qps sustained and a blended per-token hosted price.

alice_sells: For initial reply, give three buckets: self-serve Hosted (per-token tiers), Dedicated (monthly reserved GPU pools with commit tiers), and Private (license + support). Ben/priya — can you add unit estimates for the 1k qps scenario? Marco — add any compliance add-on costs.

priya_soleng: Quick sizing note: 1k qps with 128 avg tokens/response — rough Dedicated commit estimate: 6 A100s with 20% headroom for KV cache. I'll put numbers in the sheet. POC timeline draft:

```
Week 0: kick, network prep, security approvals
Week 1: smoke tests (latency, correctness)
Weeks 2-5: scale run + cost/latency tuning + quantization trials
Week 6: handoff + operational runbook
```

ben_se: I added pricing rows to the matrix (hosted per-token, reserved monthly for Dedicated, license + min support fee for Private). Left blanks for discounting — Jenna, what discount bands are we comfortable offering for an enterprise first-year commit?

jenna_ps: Standard bands: 10% for 12mo mid-size, 20% for 24mo+ strategic. For anchor deals we can go to 25% but need RevOps signoff. Also, include an implementation services estimate (one-time).

marco_security: Uploaded security pack: https://drive.redwood/cobalt/rfi/1761123345/security-responses-v1.pdf. Highlights: SOC2 report (redacted), encryption architecture diagram, incident response SLAs, support for customer‑managed KMS, and our data deletion policy. I flagged two questions we should escalate: 1) dedicated HSM requirement (need legal + infra input), 2) data residency to EU required for all backups.

alice_sells: Good catch on HSM + backups. Ben, can you mark those as "legal/infra review" in the matrix and assign owners? Also add a short blurb for the RFI summary: why Redwood is a fit (unified runtime, predictable economics, can run in their VPC). Keep it <200 words.

ben_se: Done — marked HSM -> infra@redwood, backups -> infra + compliance. Drafted 180‑word summary and added to the draft RFI doc in the drive.

priya_soleng: One more on POC logistics: recommend we request a representative dataset (sanitized) or a prompt set to reproduce clinical Q&A flows. Also need account of their expected sequence length distribution — impacts kernel selection.

jenna_ps: I'll ask the AE to get dataset/prompt set and confirm contract milestones. Also looping Legal on HSM question.

alice_sells: Action items: ben — finalize matrix + RFI summary; priya — finalize POC plan + test cases; marco — finalize security answers and note escalation items; jenna — propose pricing bands and contract template; I’ll consolidate and send back to Cobalt by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ben_se: Will do. Planning to cut v2 by EOD (will ping here when ready). :raised_hands:

rfp-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up to Cobalt in 24 hours (thread 1761123345).
